target.title: fix(auto-reply): surface periodic usage-limit failures in group chats
target.body:
Fixes #102598

## What Problem This Solves

When a provider account hits a periodic usage limit ("You've hit your weekly limit · resets 6pm (UTC)"), every group-chat turn fails silently — no error notice, indistinguishable from a dead bot. Observed in production 2026-07-09: 15+ consecutive silent failures over 10 minutes while gateway logs showed `reason=rate_limit` on each.

## Why This Change Was Made

The failover layer types these errors correctly (`FailoverError.reason: "rate_limit"` via `isPeriodicUsageLimitErrorMessage`), but the user-copy path re-derived rate-limitness from message text using the weaker `isRateLimitErrorMessage`, which doesn't match "weekly limit". Misclassified as generic → group-silent policy → `SILENT_REPLY_TOKEN` → dropped. Existing tests (`agent-runner-execution.test.ts` "surfaces rate-limit fallback copy in $label chats") prove rate-limit copy is meant to be visible in groups, so this was a classification bug, not policy.

The fix consults the typed `err.reason` first (mirroring the existing billing pattern in the same handler), in both the main failure handler and the sibling `buildKnownAgentRunFailureReplyPayload`. Mixed-cause `FallbackSummaryError` handling is unchanged. Two copy gaps fixed in the same pass: periodic-limit failures now pass through the sanitized provider detail (instead of a misleading "try again in a few minutes" for a ~10-hour weekly limit), and the rate-limit hint regex now matches "resets" as well as "reset".

## User Impact

Group/channel users get a visible "⚠️ You've hit your weekly limit · resets 6pm (UTC)." notice instead of silence when the account is limit-exhausted. Generic failures in groups remain silent by policy. DM behavior unchanged.

## Evidence

- Root-cause trace with file:line map: #102598
- `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/auto-reply/reply/agent-runner-execution.test.ts` → 242 passed (includes new group/channel visibility cases for raw periodic `FailoverError`, overloaded typed-reason regression coverage)
- `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/agents/embedded-agent-helpers.sanitizeuserfacingtext.test.ts` → 119 passed
- Affected-test sweep (`agent-runner.final-media-runreplyagent`, `failover-matches`) → 33 passed; live-profile wrapper → 37 passed (live skipped by env)
- tsgo core + core.test lanes green; oxfmt clean; structured autoreview clean
